description: This Java source file contains integration tests for the Loan Disbursement Details functionality in the Apache Fineract project. It includes test cases for creating, approving, disbursing, modifying, and validating multi-tranche loans, along with handling edge cases like over-disbursal and undo operations.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementDetailsIntegrationTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of loan disbursal, modification, approval, and related operations within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the REST assured specifications and helper objects before each test.

methods.name: createAndValidateMultiDisburseLoansBasedOnEmi
methods.description: Creates a multi-tranche loan with EMI, approves it, disburses, and validates repayment schedule.

methods.name: validateRepaymentScheduleWithEMI
methods.description: Validates the repayment schedule matches expected EMI values.

methods.name: assertRepaymentScheduleValuesWithEMI
methods.description: Asserts individual period values against expected EMI schedule.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithEmiAmount
methods.description: Submits a loan application with EMI amount and returns the loan ID.

methods.name: validateEqualInstallmentsForMultiTrancheLoan
methods.description: Creates, approves, disburses, and validates a multi-tranche loan with equal installments.

methods.name: disburseLoanWithExceededOverAppliedAmountFails
methods.description: Tests if over-disbursing more than the maximum allowed fails appropriately.

methods.name: disburseLoanWithExceededOverAppliedAmountSucceed
methods.description: Tests if over-disbursing exactly the total approved amount succeeds.

methods.name: createApproveAndValidateMultiDisburseLoan
methods.description: Creates, approves, and disburses a multi-tranche loan, validating each step.

methods.name: allowModifyLoanApplicationAfterUndoDisbursalWithTranches
methods.description: Tests scenario of modifying a loan application after undoing disbursal including tranche details.

methods.name: editLoanDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Performs edit operations on existing disbursement details and validates changes.

methods.name: addNewDisbursementDetails
methods.description: Adds additional disbursement tranches to an existing loan.

methods.name: deleteDisbursmentDetails
methods.description: Deletes last disbursement tranches from a loan.

methods.name: editDateAndPrincipalOfExistingTranche
methods.description: Modifies date and principal amount of an existing disbursed tranche and validates.

methods.name: formatExpectedDisbursementDate
methods.description: Formats disbursement date from internal array/string to human-readable format.

methods.name: buildLoanApplicationJSON
methods.description: Constructs JSON string for a loan application.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplicationWithTranches
methods.description: Submits a loan application with tranche details and returns loan ID.

methods.name: applyForMultiTrancheLoanApplication
methods.description: Submits a multi-tranche loan application and returns loan ID.

methods.name: addCollaterals
methods.description: Adds collateral information for loan application.

methods.name: collaterals
methods.description: Creates collateral map for application.

methods.name: evaluateEqualInstallmentsForRepaymentSchedule
methods.description: Validates that the repayment schedule has expected equal installments within a limit.

methods.name: overAppliedAmountFailedResponseSpec
methods.description: Defines a response specification for failed disbursal due to over-application.
